measure.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
measure.evidenceText: Price of Travel's Hostel Index table lists Cape Town, South Africa, Zebra Crossing, $13.82. The methodology states the price is per night including taxes and fees for one person in a shared dorm room, averaged over a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023.
measure.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; index published 16 Jan 2023
measure.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world Cape Town South Africa Hostel Index dorm bed price
measure.reason: Exact city row, named hostel, numeric USD nightly shared-dorm bed price, one-person basis, included taxes/fees methodology, and dated reference window are all explicit.
